maximize: Use the 0%-fee first-3-listings promo on your three highest-value items — that can save $180+ on three $500 bags. Never list items under $83 (the $10 flat fee eats 20%+); those go to Depop. Price items at or above $83 so you're in the 12% tier, not the flat-fee tier. Use the 'Make an Offer' feature: Vestiaire's data shows countering offers beats accepting or declining (27% higher average prices). Ship immediately with the free insured label — authentication adds 3–7 days, so every day you delay is a day your money waits. For the $83–$2,000 sweet spot, Vestiaire beats The RealReal's rates on mid-range designer — route those pieces here, and reserve RealReal for watches/high-end bags.
